answer_1.quote: Video captioning is a challenging cross-modal task that aims to describe videos with natural language sentences.

answer_2.quote: We test the correlation between automatic metrics and human annotation ... We test model-free metrics BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, CIDEr, COAHA, and model-based metrics BERTScore, EM-Score.

answer_4.quote: We design an annotation protocol to instruct annotators on how to measure and label the factuality of video captions. ... We hire three graduate students as our annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators give three levels of factuality annotation: paragraph-level Likert scale (1-5), sentence-level binary label, and word-level marking of factual errors.
